ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

3. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.

4. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

5. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.

6. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.

8. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
